content: Neomycin is an antibiotic derived from the metabolic products of the actinomycete Streptomyces fradiae. The product, NEO-FRADIN Oral Solution, is intended for oral administration and is formulated as a clear orange solution with a cherry flavor. Each dose contains 5 mg of neomycin. The inactive ingredients in the solution include benzoic acid, FD&C Yellow No. 6, cherry flavor, glycerin, methylparaben, propylparaben, sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate, sulfuric acid, and purified water. Sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate and sulfuric acid are specifically included to adjust the pH of the solution. The chemical name of neomycin is 0-2,6-diamino-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-0-β-D-ribofuranosyl-(1→5)-0-2-deoxy-D-streptamine. Neomycin B differs slightly in structure, as the α-D-glucopyranosyl residue in the neobiosamine moiety is replaced by β-L-idopyranosyl.
